note: LIVE evidence (LBA-REQ-025 / ADR-0016) that the sigstore-KEYLESS + public-rekor tier works end to end AND the provenance is stored on an immutable Release. The acg-keyless-attest workflow ran in GitHub Actions (OIDC), and cosign keyless-signed the committed release-provenance bundle: a short-lived Fulcio certificate bound to the workflow identity, with the signature recorded in the PUBLIC rekor transparency log; the resulting .sigstore bundle is attached to an immutable prerelease. Publicly verifiable at the rekor logIndex + release below -- cited evidence (rekor + the release are networked, not re-derivable offline).
signingTool: cosign sign-blob --yes (keyless, ambient GitHub Actions OIDC -> Fulcio)

release.note: the keyless-signed provenance is STORED ON THE RELEASE: the .sigstore bundle (Fulcio cert + rekor SET + inclusion proof), certificate, and signature are attached AT CREATION. The org enforces immutable releases, so assets are provided atomically at creation -- an earlier post-hoc upload returned HTTP 422, and a burned immutable tag cannot be reused (hence v0.0.2). This closes LBA-REQ-025's last clause.
